text:
3D Artist Slava Izvekov breaks down the creation of a realistic Traffic Light. In this article, Slava discusses references, subdivision modelling, ZBrush detailing, floating geometry, low-poly optimisation, UVs & baking. He also covers texturing painted metal, rust, plastic & damaged wires using substance3dart Painter. Article in bio.
